meta.title: AcrossFlare
meta.description: Secure cloud and network optimization services

legal.disclaimer: These pages describe how AcrossFlare currently operates. They are not legal advice. Local law may impose extra duties on you or on us.

termsSections.title: 1. The service
termsSections.body: AcrossFlare provides two paid products: Global (VLESS access plus Vaultwarden and Syncthing backup) and Marketing IP (HTTP/SOCKS5 and WireGuard endpoints). Accounts, plans, and credentials are issued through acrossflare.com after payment or manual admin provisioning.

termsSections.title: 2. Accounts
termsSections.body: You must provide an accurate email and keep your password secret. You are responsible for activity on your account, including shared credentials such as proxy URLs, WireGuard keys, and Vaultwarden or Syncthing access.

termsSections.title: 3. Acceptable use
termsSections.body: You may use the service only for lawful purposes. You must not use AcrossFlare to attack networks, commit fraud, distribute malware, exploit minors, evade lawful process, or violate export or sanctions rules. We may suspend or delete an account that we reasonably believe is abusing nodes, storage, or other customers.

termsSections.title: 4. Payments and plans
termsSections.body: Prices are shown in the currency that follows your language. Card and Alipay charges are processed by PortOne, Stripe, or Paymentwall. A successful payment starts provisioning. Traffic, backup quota, and node bindings follow the plan you buy. Unused traffic does not roll over unless a plan says otherwise. Withdrawals and refunds follow section 5.

termsSections.title: 5. Withdrawals and refunds
termsSections.body:
This is a digital service. Provisioning starts as soon as payment succeeds. After a subscription is active and credentials or backup access have been issued, the right to withdraw from the contract may be limited under applicable e-commerce rules. We disclose that before you pay.

Email acrosstool@gmail.com within 7 days of payment for a full refund if (1) payment succeeded but credentials were not issued or provisioning failed, or (2) the charge was duplicated or clearly erroneous.

We do not pro-rate unused days after credentials have been issued, unless a mandatory law says otherwise. Refunds go back to the original payment method and may take several days through the payment provider.

termsSections.title: 6. Availability
termsSections.body: Nodes, panels, and storage may move, fail over, or go offline. We try to keep access working, including spare nodes where a plan includes them, but we do not warrant uninterrupted circumvention or a particular exit IP.

termsSections.title: 7. Termination
termsSections.body: You may stop using the service at any time. We may end a subscription that is unpaid, abusive, or required by law. When a subscription ends, proxy clients and backup access may be revoked without a separate notice period.

termsSections.title: 8. Liability
termsSections.body: The service is provided as available. To the extent allowed by law, AcrossFlare is not liable for lost profits, lost data, or indirect damages, and total liability for a claim is limited to the fees you paid for the affected subscription in the prior three months.

termsSections.title: 9. Changes
termsSections.body: We may update these terms. Continued use after a posted change means you accept the new terms. Questions: acrosstool@gmail.com.

privacySections.title: 1. Data we collect
privacySections.body: We store the email and password hash you register with, session cookies, plan and payment records, provisioned credentials (such as client UUIDs, proxy secrets, and backup usernames), and operational logs needed to run the service.

privacySections.title: 2. Network and security data
privacySections.body: Traffic to acrossflare.com goes through Cloudflare. We may see the connecting IP Cloudflare reports (CF-Connecting-IP). Node software (3x-ui / Xray), Vaultwarden, and Syncthing keep their own access and usage records so quotas and abuse controls work.

privacySections.title: 3. Processors
privacySections.body: Payments are handled by PortOne, Stripe, and/or Paymentwall. Hosting, DNS, WAF, and TLS may use Cloudflare and our VPS providers. Encrypted passwords and notes live in Vaultwarden. Files sync through Syncthing. We do not sell your personal information.

privacySections.title: 4. Retention
privacySections.body: Account and billing records are kept while the account is open and as long as tax or dispute rules require. Session cookies expire. Provisioned secrets are removed or rotated when a plan changes, migrates, or ends, except copies that remain in backups for a limited time.

privacySections.title: 5. Your choices
privacySections.body: You can access or update account email through the console, and you can ask us to delete an account at acrosstool@gmail.com unless we must keep records for law or security. Do not send payment card numbers to that inbox.
